args.subject: Private Dining Table Request for 12 – Friday, May 24, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a private dining table for 12 guests at New Asiaway on Friday, May 24, 2024.

Could you please let me know your availability that evening and share any available time slots, along with details on your private dining menus, pricing, and any minimum spend requirements? Please also let me know if a deposit or advance confirmation is needed.

Restaurant address on file: 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France
Phone: +33 1 23 45 67 89

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
